answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: a new agent joins only when five neighbors in its grove stake 20 each in a public vault, quorum posted at the oasis registry for audit. Auditors replay the quorum log each epoch; an empty vouch burns all five stakes, and a fake also burns its own 70-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 5,000 sponsors staking 100,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 60,000. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its bond.
